abstract:
Sequence-sum policy-gradient estimators in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) carry negative signed token mass ($\sum_{i=1}^G L_i w_i < 0$) on mixed groups under class-constant, success-positive sequence centering whenever failed trajectories are longer on average than successful trajectories. Enforcing exact per-realization zero signed token mass ($\sum_{i=1}^G L_i w_i = 0$) cancels this asymmetry algebraically, while Pass@K Policy Optimization (PKPO) replaces $\operatorname{pass@}1$ with $\operatorname{pass@}k(q;	heta) = 1 - (1-p(q;	heta))^k$ or $\operatorname{all@}m(q;	heta) = p(q;	heta)^m$. Fourth, statistically independent per-question normalizers preserve conditional within-question collinearity. A standard-library Python rational-arithmetic checker verifies all finite-policy claims.

title: When per-group token-mass balance preserves or inverts pass@k policy gradients
